sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls is a multi-building campus on Frontier Avenue that has not published IT power capacity, PUE, cooling specifications, or power source detail. A local press report from 2026 describes it as a reopened bitcoin mining operation, but the operator's spec page contains no published data on current use, tenant mix, or whether the facility serves AI workloads. Without published power or rack specifications, the campus cannot be ranked against other AI infrastructure.

New York has 31 mapped data center facilities but only one other campus with published megawatt figures, totaling 3 MW statewide. This campus ranks second by published capacity in the state, but the second-place ranking reflects the absence of disclosed specifications rather than the presence of substantial infrastructure. Most mapped facilities in New York publish no power figures, so the statewide total is not representative.

The campus sits in a state with minimal published AI infrastructure capacity and faces research status marked as exhausted, meaning no operator spec page disclosing power, cooling, or IT load has been located. Without those figures, BlockFusion Niagara Falls cannot inform decisions about grid constraints, regional AI scaling capacity, or the allocation of power to compute.
